value.rationale: The Heawood graph is the canonical Fano incidence graph with full 336-point-line symmetry. A complete 412-subgroup integral homotopy spectrum is a natural exact equivariant invariant: it exhibits two distinct sphere-wedge types, a mixed-dimensional sphere-circle wedge and empty loci. None is determined from the six three-spheres of the ambient complex or its rational homology character. The full group/class frequencies make the classification reusable as a finite benchmark for related complexes.
